## Description

Thecate freshwater dinoflagellate (123–300 × 28–42 µm) with a long apical horn and two posterior
horns of different length; yellow-brown chloroplasts; a transverse flagellum in the cingulum and a
longitudinal one. Planktonic in lakes, where it migrates in the water column.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 2 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

The body (~60 × 35 µm) plus three [body processes](../../mechanics/shape-changes.md#silhouettes-and-processes): an
apical horn (~90 µm) and antapical horns of ~40 and ~20 µm, joined by the silhouette. The cellulose
theca gives the highest shape memory of the pack. Phototroph with helical swimming.

## Not implemented yet

- Daughters are born with all horns; really each regenerates the half theca it lacks.
- No vertical migration (no vertical axis); no cysts.

## Unique and shared mechanics

The reference being for [body processes and silhouettes](../../mechanics/shape-changes.md); its horns protect it
from predators via [mouth width](../../mechanics/feeding-and-phagocytosis.md#mouth-width). Shares
[helical swimming](../../mechanics/locomotion.md) with the other dinoflagellates.
